info.title: API.SH: Research Papers
info.description: The Research Papers API from API.SH: public Research Papers data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The works registered with a researcher's ORCID iD: their name as published, affiliations seen on their papers, the total number of works and the works themselves (same fields as /papers/v1/search), with type, year and keyword filters and sorts. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/papers-author

parameters.name: orcid
parameters.description: ORCID iD (16 digits with dashes, or the orcid.org URL).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords to search within the researcher's works.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Work type (journal-article, book-chapter, proceedings-article, posted-content, dataset...).

parameters.name: from_year
parameters.description: Published in or after this year.

parameters.name: to_year
parameters.description: Published in or before this year.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Typeahead suggestions for works, authors, journals and other sources, institutions, topics, concepts, publishers or funders: id, name, a hint (e.g. the authors or the country), works and citation counts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/papers-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The works that cite a given work (by DOI or work id): the cited work's title, year and citation count, the total number of citing works, and each citing work's DOI, work id, title, type, publication date, authors (name, ORCID, position, institutions), journal or venue, ISSN, publisher, volume, issue, pages, language, its own citation count and open-access status and link. Filter by year range, type, open access or keywords; sort by most cited, newest or oldest. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (paging stops at 10,000 results).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/papers-citations

parameters.name: doi
parameters.description: DOI of the cited work (or its doi.org URL). Pass this or `work_id`.

parameters.name: work_id
parameters.description: Work id of the cited work (the `work_id` of a result, e.g. `W2919115771`), for works without a DOI; instead of `doi`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords to search within the citing works.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Citing work type (article, review, preprint, book-chapter, conference-paper, dataset, dissertation...).

parameters.name: from_year
parameters.description: Published in or after this year.

parameters.name: to_year
parameters.description: Published in or before this year.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A research topic (OpenAlex topic, e.g. T10017) or concept (e.g. C41008148), or the best topic for `q`: name, description, keywords, its subfield, field and domain (topics), level, ancestors and related concepts (concepts), works and citation counts, links, and its most-cited (or newest) works.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/papers-concept

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An OpenAlex topic id (T...) or concept id (C...).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Find the best-matching topic by name instead.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Works page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches 150M+ scholarly works (journal articles, books and chapters, conference papers, preprints, datasets, theses) by keywords, author or title: DOI, title, type, dates, authors with ORCID and affiliations, journal, publisher, volume/issue/pages, ISSN/ISBN, subjects, citation and reference counts, abstract (when deposited), licences, funders and full-text links. Filter by years, type, journal ISSN, funder, abstract or licence; sort by relevance, newest, citations or updated. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` (valid for 5 minutes); null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/papers-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
